briefs.title: Sales Hit $17B, a Governor Candidate Vows Tax Repeal, and Psilocybin Edges Toward FDA Filing
briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.top: Michigan operators have real tailwinds this week — record cumulative sales, a fresh tribal-land dispensary launch, and a gubernatorial candidate campaigning on killing the 24% wholesale tax. Nationally, a DEA pause on rescheduling is a speed bump, not a dead end, while Compass Pathways' psilocybin program and a wave of cannabis M&A keep the bigger trendlines pointed up.

local.text: Hempire Collective opens first tribal-land dispensary — The family-owned operator cut the ribbon on its newest Mt. Pleasant store on Saginaw Chippewa tribal land, a new retail frontier that required AG-level sign-off to pull off.

Michigan cannabis sales cross $17 billion lifetime — The CRA's latest monthly report shows combined adult-use and medical sales have surpassed $17 billion since legalization, generating an estimated $2.66 billion in state taxes.
Michigan brands roll out Halloween seasonal drops — Local cannabis companies are leaning into product innovation with themed fall releases as Q4 competition heats up.

Gov. candidate James pledges to repeal 24% tax — Backed by roughly $90,000 in industry checks, GOP candidate John James has pledged to repeal the wholesale tax if elected, giving operators a political path to relief.

Tax lawsuit advances toward trial as CRA cracks down — A judge let MiCIA's challenge to the 24% wholesale tax proceed toward trial, even as regulators hit a major vape producer with a record $2 million fine — both signs the state is sorting out winners under the new rules.

national.text: DEA rescheduling hits a pause, not a dead end — A DEA administrative law judge stayed the marijuana rescheduling hearing to weigh a new GAO report, but the completed hearing record stands and the government must respond by Oct. 13.

Compass Pathways nears FDA filing for psilocybin drug — COMP360 hit statistically significant results in back-to-back Phase 3 trials, and with a rolling NDA review and National Priority Voucher in hand, the company is targeting a Q4 submission.

MAHA Summit spotlights psychedelic medicine's momentum — HHS and FDA officials joined Compass Pathways' CEO and other psychedelic executives to discuss psilocybin's potential for the 4 million Americans with treatment-resistant depression.

Vireo Growth to acquire Planet 13 in landmark MSO deal — The all-stock transaction adds 36 dispensaries, three cultivation facilities and a consumption lounge license to Vireo's expanding multistate portfolio.

RWB expands into Germany with HEAL Europe buy — The company closed its majority acquisition of HEAL Europe Holdings, entering the German medical cannabis market after repositioning its Canadian platform.
